title: Indian Club Swinging
tagline: Trace the path. Keep the flow.
description: A calm rhythm game inspired by the mugdar and jori, the heavy wooden clubs of South Asian wrestling-gym training. Trace a glowing marker round circles, ovals and figure eights with one finger while two weighty clubs follow, and build a flow multiplier from move to move. Six routines and a daily routine, Practice at any tempo, a Watch and Learn demonstration with time to think, a Rules page and text size up to 300%. Synthesised sound, no ads, works offline.
howToPlay: Pick a routine. Four clicks count you in, then the first move begins.
Press and drag on the sand. The brass-ringed club follows your finger with a little lag.
A glowing ring runs round a ghost path. Keep the club head inside the ring.
Stay close to build flow and your multiplier, from x1 to x5. Lift your finger and the clubs drop.
Each beat is judged smooth, good or off. Two beats between moves show the next path.
Practice drills one move at any tempo. Watch and Learn shows a routine with time to think.
Use the Hint button to see the start point and direction again.
On a keyboard: drag with the mouse, Space pauses, H shows the hint.
